memory_candidates.content: When a shell test suite isolates environment knobs for a library with multiple env-overridable settings (e.g. push-grant-lib.sh's PUSH_GRANT_KEY_PATH, PUSH_GRANT_DIR, PG_EXPIRY_WINDOW), isolate ALL of them in the fixture setup, not just the ones that were obviously test-breaking at authoring time. A session-wide ambient override of an unisolated knob (this machine exports PG_EXPIRY_WINDOW=1800 via settings.json, vs. the library's 600s default) can make a hardcoded fixture offset silently pass vacuously instead of exercising the intended code path, producing a failure that reproduces deterministically and looks like a production-code defect (grant-matching/test-isolation) but is actually a suite-isolation gap.
